Frequently Asked Questions

What is OBU Health?

Obu Health is your trusted source for the latest and safest solutions for effective weight loss, hair growth, skin care and more. Our platform offers personalized, private, and convenient healthcare solutions, all without ever leaving your home. Our telehealth team is committed to top quality care with US Based Board-Certified physicians. Explore our range of services today and witness firsthand the seamless path to achieving better health. Benefit from confidential treatment and complimentary shipping all at affordable prices. No insurance required.

What is the OBU Health process?

Utilizing the Obu Health platform is a very easy process. Just choose the therapy you need, click “Start My Visit” and answer a few medical questions. Our US based doctors will then review your information and prescribe medications when appropriate. You will hear back from one of our doctors in about 24 hours. In some States, a video consultation or phone consultation may be required. In those States, one of our doctors will contact you and complete your consultation via the required method.

How much does OBU Health cost?

If medication therapy is appropriate, you will be able to purchase it through the Obu Health platform at far lower costs than other sites and even cheaper than your local pharmacy.
